summary: Experience showed that 6to4, an IPv6 transition mechanism from RFC 3056, works poorly when used in its anycast mode across the open Internet. This document deprecates the anycast prefix for 6to4 relay routers defined in RFC 3068 and recommends against using anycast 6to4. It is a best current practice.

eli5.summary: A shortcut that helped people move from the old road system to the new one turned out to cause traffic jams and wrong turns. This note says to stop using that shortcut.
